title: Luna: persistent tool documentation
description: Both conditions use Luna/high, the same planner, two native cameras, observed-cloud views, whole-hand previews and eight anchored interaction memories. Only retention of previously consulted tool schemas differs. No demonstrations or inherited task experience.
scope: Paired development pilot: one fresh episode per case and documentation condition. Both use identical visual tools, anchored memory and numerical backend. This isolates documentation retention; eight episodes cannot establish reliability or generalization.
